digest.component_or_area: LLM provider abstraction and Bedrock integration
propositions: rebar's LLM runtime rejects base_url/api_key configuration outright despite documentation claiming they work, blocking OpenAI-compatible gateway and custom endpoint use cases

Anthropic-specific provider behavior is hardcoded via string matching on resolved model names rather than abstracted through provider plugins, preventing first-class support for AWS Bedrock and other providers

Bedrock-hosted Anthropic Claude models have no integration path; routing through an external OpenAI-compatible gateway loses prompt caching, structured output, native retry/timeout handling, and accurate model attribution in signed verdicts

Provenance recorded in signed verdict sidecars uses opaque model strings that conflate provider, endpoint, and tier information, blocking consumers from distinguishing first-class verdicts from best-effort ones

Output mode selection for structured outputs is hardcoded against a provider-name-matching set rather than querying the model's actual capability profile, breaking for models served through alternative providers or gateways
